summary: Derive the cookie domain (auth) and the relative-URL origin (parser abs()) from the configured base_url so non-US marketplaces like amazon.ca work, instead of hardcoding www.amazon.com / .amazon.com.
reason: base_url / AMAZON_ORDERS_BASE_URL already route fetches to the configured storefront, but the auth login/refresh/status cookie domain and the browser-session proof were pinned to .amazon.com, and the parser resolved relative order/track/invoice links against https://www.amazon.com. On amazon.ca that reads cookies for the wrong domain and emits .com detail links. Config.CookieDomain() and parser.originFromBaseURL() now both follow base_url's host.
validated_outcome: auth import --curl from an amazon.ca request sets base_url=https://www.amazon.ca and reports cookie domain .amazon.ca; parsed detail URLs resolve to amazon.ca.
